The children's story that is not for children...

When there's no water, you have to play dirty.

Woman as she is...all things to men!
Gloria / Lady in a Hurry / Assurdina Caì / Nunzia / Giovanna
Young Girl Friend (segment "La strega bruciata viva")

35104: Two best friends, Grant and Paul, hita country road for a night of fun, but unfortunately take a short cut to their fate...where they meet the Locals.
35360: The epic love story tells the tragic tale of young Vietnamese bar girl Kim, orphaned by war, who falls in love with American GI Chris — but their lives are torn apart by the fall of Saigon.
The Extraordinary 25th Anniversary Performance Recorded Live in London's West End

36128: Seven strangers wake up in a mansion in the middle of nowhere to discover they are part of a twisted game. They will have 60 minutes to choose one person to die; otherwise, all of them will be murdered. As the clock ticks down, the most lurid secrets will come to light, and they’ll discover they are all connected by a dark past.
There's a hell in every secret.
36384: The story of the Serbian army, led by the King Peter, through the World War I.
36640: La vida ha llevado a Julián Pérez por caminos equivocados, pero el destino le presentará a este hombre la oportunidad de encontrar su redención cuando es enviado a la misión más peligrosa y noble de toda su vida, una misión ordenada por la única autoridad que todavía respeta, su madre, Doña Elvira. 36896: Special prosecutor John Conroy hopes to combat organized crime and appoints his cop father Matt as chief investigator. Today's most sensational story of racket-busting !
37152: Moments from the uncompromisingly bleak existence of a secretary, her intellectually disabled sister, aloof and uneasy teacher boyfriend, bizarre neighbor and irritating workmate.
37408: A criminal lawyer Canan, divides her time in the courthouse and mother's hospital bed at night. She has to make a moral choice that will affect lives of her mother, judge and murder suspect client.
37664: In his quest to become successful, Aditya Parikh puts life on the back burner, including his Father Bipin Chandra Parikh. 37920: Yu, a self-assured factory guard, fancies himself a detective and begins poking his nose into a murder investigation.
38176: Documentary about the victorious German national football team - called "Die Mannschaft" - and their journey to the 2014 FIFA World Cup in Brazil.

Hunted, raped, and tormented out of her mind...
39200: A five-year-old boy named Aravindan is abandoned by his mother at the Mookambika Temple. Afterwards, a local hotelier raises him, but he always hopes to meet his mother.

He came back from the dead to possess a man's soul, make love to his woman, and get the Vengeance he craved!
39968: Chiara Ferragni, the first fashion influencer in the world, reveals how the digital revolution has changes business world, communication, fashion, culture, through a portrait in which she's the protagonist, both as a woman and as digital entrepreneur.

40736: Four Black transgender sex workers in Atlanta and New York City break down the walls of their profession.

41760: Set right before Christmas, young reindeer Niko must deal with his mother's remarriage and his being tasked with looking after his little stepbrother.
Small things come in big packages

Towering above the skyline ~ an indestructible creature whose eyes rain death and destruction!

The search for the real dad will lead them to a crossroads much bigger than the one they set out to face.
43808: A successful executive fights back when a scorned young lover takes his obsession too far.
44064: Mad scientist injects his enemies with acromegaly virus, causing them to become hideously deformed.

The offences are disproportionately serious compared to the financial benefits they try to secure
Blackmail leads to murder in a small town.

SHOW OF SHOWS...AND YOUR ENTERTAINMENT DELIGHT OF ALL TIME!

His career is in jeopardy... His marriage is in ruins... And his life is in danger... HE'S THROUGH NEGOTIATING.

A comedy about fame and fortune and a guy who has no chance at either.

51744: Four youngsters upset with their lives plan to kill themselves in a farmhouse where they experience paranormal activities.
